night_arena.png.prompt:
A beautiful hand-painted top-down game map, orthographic straight-down view, showing an ENTIRE small battle arena for a cute cartoon action game: the clearing just outside a Japanese cat village on a moonlit night.

Composition: a wide open grassy clearing filling the whole frame, with worn dirt paths crossing it. Around the outer edge, softly darker terrain framing the play area - a few mossy boulders, low bushes, a broken wooden fence on one side, a small stone lantern, a couple of pine and maple trees whose canopies are seen from above, and a shallow stream with a plank bridge crossing one corner. Keep the CENTRE two thirds of the image open and uncluttered so game characters standing there stay easy to read.

Make it genuinely pretty: rich layered greens, warm ochre paths, cool silver-blue moonlight, scattered pale wildflowers, a few fallen maple leaves, gentle painterly texture and soft ambient shading where grass meets stone.

Lighting: soft moonlight from above, even overall exposure across the whole map, no harsh cast shadows, no strong vignette, no visible light source, nothing overexposed.

Style: hand-painted storybook illustration for a high quality indie game, flat-ish cartoon colour with soft painterly gradients and delicate darker linework on the stones, fences and foliage. Matching a cute cat ninja game.

Do NOT include: any characters or creatures, any text, any watermark, any user interface, any grid lines, any border or frame around the image, any isometric or perspective tilt - it must be a flat straight-down view.

Output a single 1536x1024 PNG (3:2 landscape). Save the image as night_arena.png in the current directory and report the path.
